question: Taking 28 g an ounce and 0.84 square metres a square yard, what is 14-ounce-per-square-yard denim in grams per square metre?
move: Convert every unit in a rate, the bottom as well as the top.
trap: Converting the ounces and stopping at about 392 grams.
hint: Convert the weight first, then spread it over a square metre instead of a square yard.
steps: 14 ounces x 28 g = 392 g per square yard.
A square yard is only 0.84 of a square metre, so divide by 0.84.
source: NIST, Guide for the Use of SI Units
reference: Thompson & Taylor, Guide for the Use of the International System of Units (SI), NIST Special Publication 811, 2008
